title: Four end-to-end closures: sole-channel contract, real launch-shaped running, durable ACK succession, bounded versioned client
statement: One whole-subsystem goal with four larger end-to-end product closures, preserving all nine wave-35 acceptance points. (1) The sole channel's lease/guard/RPC contract is pinned at the real service boundary, including the separation between a closed callback channel and physical finalization. (2) An in-process RunnerHost at the existing RunnerHost boundary returns a real RunningAttempt (feed/stop/waitExit/attachPort/attachCallbacks) consumed through the unique channel with zero native spawn; NativeProductAttempt.launch's own class callbacks remain NOT_REACHED. (3) A lost receipt is reconciled from the Runner journal plus the original Store with the same fact id and same row sequence, so durable ACK needs no second ledger. (4) A typed client fixes the client/server argument order, and compatibility refusals are bounded and non-settling. Channel module unchanged; new additions are two production modules (in-process host, typed client).

additionsThisWave: inprocess-host.ts: InProcessRunnerHost/createInProcessHost implement RunnerHost.launch over the real serveRunner/endpoint with a caller-supplied driver and callbacks; stop() reports indeterminate unless the caller confirms
typed-client.ts: openAttachClient binds producer at connect time and exposes state/next/reply/inspect/cancel/command/facts/payload with the real client arity

handoff.detail: To obtain the original class callbacks from a real launch without a native spawn, main should accept an injectable transport/host in launch (the shape InProcessRunnerHost already implements: RunnerHost.launch returning RunningAttempt). Until then the class-callback path stays NOT_REACHED and the embedded host is the only zero-native real-launch consumer.

Natural terminal leaves admission open until an explicit cancel; the candidate's no-lease cancel refusal breaks main's waitExit→quiesce completion. I evidence: actual-terminal-finalize.test.ts. Fix belongs to B's control admission; do not relax terminal callback guards.

RecoveryRunnerPort documents server-side (producer, leaseId, generation) while connectRunnerRecovery's client takes (leaseId, generation). openAttachClient in apps/runner/src/attach-channel/typed-client.ts is the typed workaround; a typed client interface in packages/execution should replace the implicit shape.

A native intent created while the stdio lease is still current is settled indeterminate by the attach takeover (correct, but surprising). Main must bind (first channelNext) before feeding begin; documented in the manual §5.0f code sample.
